messages:
Erin: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners/timelines for tightening rollout scope and adding escalation timers. recurring pattern: small config change -> large blast radius. can we list actions and owners here?
Peter: +1. propose 3 tiers: canary(1%), small-batch(5%), full-rollout. add auto-rollback at each tier if error-rate or latency spikes.
Sami: wrote a flag config sketch for progressive ramping and automatic rollback. sharing snippet:
```json
{
  "flag": "new-encoder",
  "stages": [
    {"name": "canary", "pct": 1, "rollback_on": {"5xx_rate": 0.02, "p95_latency_ms": 800} },
    {"name": "small-batch", "pct": 5, "rollback_on": {"5xx_rate": 0.01, "p95_latency_ms": 600} }
  ]
}
```
Sami: implementation notes: autoscaler + fallback model variant must be a sibling variant. if rollback triggers, route to stable-quantized model.
Lucy: I can own the rollout-engine changes (gate + timer implementation). Target: POC by next Wed, rollout infra PR by end of sprint.
Erin: thanks lucy. can you add an operational timer: if a stage is past threshold for >2 min without a human ack, auto-rollback? we had manual ack delays in the incident.
Lucy: yes. propose timer=120s, ack window=90s for oncall. will add owner in the ticket.
Peter: i'll own the alerting thresholds and telemetry hooks. will add dashboards: 5xx rate by flag stage, p95 by stage, and rollout-progress gauge. ETA: 1 week.
Erin: who takes cleanup of the legacy wide-scope flags (the ones that caused cross-service traffic spike)?
Sami: i'll take inventory and add a migration plan. start with a sweep to mark flags with >20% global exposure. plan + owners by Fri.
ops-bot: Deploy-Log: deploy 2023-11-07T14:03:22Z - service encoder-v2 - flagged by canary 1% - errors spiked at 14:05:10Z (5xx rate 3.4%)
Peter: recurring incident note: pattern shows lack of per-flag stage telemetry. until dashboards exist, enforce manual pause between stages (30m) for high-risk flags.
Erin: action list recap (assignments + due dates) — please confirm:
- Lucy: rollout-engine timers + auto-rollback POC (due next Wed)
- Peter: dashboards + alerting hooks (due 1 week)
- Sami: flag inventory + migration plan (due Fri)
- Erin: coordinate postmortem check-in and update runbook (I'll do by Monday)
Lucy: confirmed.
Peter: confirmed.
Sami: confirmed.
Erin: one more ask — add a short playbook snippet to the runbook: step-by-step emergency rollback command and ownership contact list. keeps response time down.
Lucy: will add to runbook when POC lands.
Erin: thanks all. i'll create the tracker ticket and link PRs. if anyone hits blockers ping me and @oncall. :thumbsup:
